Just in Time Support
Suggest students make a factor tree to rewrite each value as the product of
its prime factors and then rewrite pairs of identical prime factors as perfect
squares to extract.
COMMON MISCONCEPTION
Students may think the Worked Example demonstrates the use of the product
of powers rule; however, the product of powers rule applies when the bases
are the same. In this case, the exponents are the same, and the bases can be
multiplied by applying the power of a power rule.

Use integer exponents to remind students of the power of a power rule and
show how it connects to the process in the Worked Example.
